_classes.name: dissolution_transfer_stored_as_duty

2009-A8956-03.note: 'the chief administrator may not eliminate the requirement of consent until after he or she shall have consulted with members of the organized bar' is a precondition of -02, not a stand-alone duty (borderline: it is a prohibition on the actor).
2009-A8956-03.quote: the chief administrator may not eliminate the requirement of consent until after he or she shall have consulted with members of the organized bar in any county in which such elimination shall apply, have afforded them the opportunity to submit comments with respect thereto, and have considered any such comments.
